# Car Atlas

> Car Atlas is an encyclopedia of every car ever made, makes, models, generations, and flagship specs, with a buying layer that routes each model to the channels where it actually changes hands, and a registry of the clubs that keep the marques alive. It is built in the open, wave by wave.

The dataset lives in `data/v1/` as plain JSON and is the single source of truth: the pages, the search index, and the API all read the same files, and functions never fabricate data, what they return is what the dataset holds, with its date on it. As of 2026-10-13 the atlas holds 59 makes, 257 models, and 469 generations, plus 46 clubs and networks. `python3 scripts/build.py` validates the schema and regenerates the search index and the model pages' baked snapshot; it fails loudly on drift. Prices are never invented: Price Watch publishes certified auction results, each with its source and date, in `data/v1/price-watch.json` and on the Buy page, and the listing schema is published alongside them.

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): instant search over the whole atlas, browse by make, era, and body style, and the coverage notes.
- [Buy](buy.html): the four buying classes, the 13 curated channels with editorial notes, and the Price Watch schema.
- [Clubs](clubs.html): the clubs and networks registry, filterable by region and marque.

## Records

- [Porsche](make.html?make=porsche): a make page, the marque's story, facts, and every model in the atlas. One per make, at `make.html?make=<slug>`.
- [Porsche 911](model.html?make=porsche&model=911): a model record, generations with flagship specs, collector note, trims, and where to buy. One per model, at `model.html?make=<make>&model=<model>`.
- [Tucker 48](model.html?make=tucker&model=48): a model record from the historic marques, the same format, for a car built for one year.

## Data

- [Makes index](data/v1/makes.json): every make in the atlas, with the dataset's own `updatedAt` date.
- [Search index](data/v1/search-index.json): the single generated file the homepage loads; rebuilt by `scripts/build.py`, never edited by hand.
- [Porsche model records](data/v1/models/porsche.json): the per-make model files, one JSON per make under `data/v1/models/`, each holding that make's models, generations, and specs.
- [Buying data](data/v1/buying.json): the four buying classes, the 13 channels, and the Price Watch schema.
- [Price Watch results](data/v1/price-watch.json): the certified auction results (stages 1–6), car, price, house, date, and a linked published source per record.
- [Clubs registry](data/v1/clubs.json): the 46 clubs and networks, with regions and chapter models.

## API

- [API notes](API.md): the envelope shape, caching, and the five endpoints, health, makes, model, search, clubs, served by the functions under `api/` over the same `data/v1/` dataset. The frontend does not depend on them.
